title: Explicit underived and homotopy open comparison models
statement: For a scheme morphism $h:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme] and an arbitrary open $U\subseteq Y$, put $V=h^{-1}U$, $g:V\to U$, and let $j_X,j_Y$ be the open inclusions. The underived composition model is $j_{X*}h_*\cong g_*j_{Y*}$, constructed using pushforward composition, the equality $j_Xh=gj_Y$, and inverse pushforward composition. The underived restriction model is $h_*r_Y\cong r_Xg_*$, obtained by transport along the open-site equivalences [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] of the sectionwise inverse-image identification of Tag 08FE. Their homotopy models include the explicit mapHomotopyCategory composition factors. The homotopy adjunction is the termwise open adjunction [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data] localized at homotopy equivalences. These are real constructions, with no chosen existence witness.

source.place: Tags 08FE, 0D5T and 08BV; official pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08FE, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0D5T and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08BV, read 2026-10-14

proof.text: Construct the underived composition from pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr. Construct the restriction comparison using the sectionwise inverse-image-open equality and morphismRestrict_app, transported along overFunctorEquiv. Apply mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso to construct the two homotopy models. Apply mapHomotopyCategory to the specialized underived adjunction. All construction and compatibility proofs are written in Lean.
